narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a comic medieval fable with a twist, brisk and excited, never calm.

knight.instruct: Boastful young knight fresh from victory, loud, cocky and very pleased with himself.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He just won the tournament. Now a gold box promises him exactly what he deserves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's a medieval test. Three sealed caskets: gold, silver, and plain lead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This morning he knocked every rider into the mud.

lines.speaker: knight
lines.text: Undefeated! Who deserves it more than me?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the corner, a quiet woman waits her turn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The gold lid reads: whoso chooseth me shall find that he deserveth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His I-deserve-it needle slams into the red. His hand goes straight for the gold.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lid lifts. Dust, and dead men's bones. A skull rolls into his lap.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Silver promises what his nature desires. Inside, earth and worms.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You see, in twenty fourteen, researcher Lisa Cavanaugh studied when people treat themselves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The best predictor wasn't their mood. It was feeling they deserved it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His victory pumps that feeling up, and it shoves his hand to the gold.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The gold box never had to be good. It only had to tell a winner he'd earned it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the woman ignores the needle and opens plain lead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside, fine gold and precious stones.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Today that gold box has a price tag, and the same three words.
